title: [BUG] [alpha] useLinkedEditing getTagAtPosition has end-column off-by-one
summary: Tag end column is computed as start + length, which includes one character past the tag name; hit test includes closing bracket column.
steps: Call getTagAtPosition on '<div>' with cursor at column 5 (on '>').
Observe function treats '>' column as inside tag name range.
expected: Tag name 'div' should occupy columns 2..4 only.
actual: Computed end column includes column 5, causing false-positive tag hit.
